summary: This room is the palace's synthesis/DSP neighborhood alphabetized P through W — mostly well-tended, already densely cross-linked internally (Kuramoto Coupling, Frequency-Time Duality, Hyperdimensional Prism, Boundary-Crossing Instruments recur as connective tissue). The community-lens work here wasn't finding missed links inside the room — folks here already talk to each other — it was two things: (1) a genuinely unreached member, control-vocabulary-math (reached_by 0), which turns out to be a natural sibling of Signal-Rate CV Architecture — both formalize the same neural-suite control layer from different angles (statistical math vs. architectural principle) and nobody had drawn the line between them; (2) a real cross-cluster bridge — The Metaphor Stretch (crystal-synthesis instrument design) and ControlNet as Topology (a September newcomer from the BLUELINE/GenAI world) turn out to be the same pattern in different material: a physical or geometric substrate underdetermines the final render, and the designer makes named, explicit choices (Decision Points / canyon-width) about how tight the constraint runs and what claim the result makes. Also found: Wavetable Space as Torus's "Cross-Domain Resonances" section carries four structurally-significant [[wikilink]] section headers (Orbital Resonance, Quasicrystals, Tonnetz, Berry Phase) plus one inline (Plato (Socratic method)) pointing at entries that don't exist in the palace — ghost links, noted but not touched per instructions.

typed_relations.label: control-layer-siblings
typed_relations.rationale: Both entries formalize the exact same instrument's control layer (the Action Potential Oscillator / neural synthesis suite) from complementary angles: Signal-Rate CV Architecture is the architectural discipline (every input a per-sample CV jack, no control-rate parameters); control-vocabulary-math is the statistical math that turns the resulting continuous population into '4-5 smooth, performable knobs' (r, K, sigma_threshold, mean firing rate). Neither currently points at the other, though both point at Action Potential Oscillator/Kuramoto Coupling independently. control-vocabulary-math is currently reached_by 0 in this room — this is a genuine, needed inbound link, not a courtesy one.
typed_relations.evidence: 'This document formalizes the layer that sits *on top* of that engine: the statistical descriptors that turn a noisy crowd of N spiking neurons into four or five smooth, performable knobs.' (control-vocabulary-math) / 'The design principle that every input in the neural synthesis suite... operates at signal rate. No control-rate parameters. Every input is a CV jack.' (Signal-Rate CV Architecture)
typed_relations.deep_pattern: Fidelity test: swap Signal-Rate CV Architecture for State Machine (also room-adjacent, also touches the neural suite) — the reasoning collapses, since State Machine is about discrete-phase logic, not continuous performable knobs. The pairing is specific to the shared control-surface concern.

bridge_findings.thought: A September newcomer (reached_by 5) about diffusion-model steering, framed as sculpting: a physical/geometric armature (ControlNet) carves a canyon the base probability terrain never held, and the designer chooses how tight a canyon to carve (depth pins the surface, pose frees it — 'choose your conditioner by how tight a canyon you want').
bridge_findings.shared_structure: The Metaphor Stretch names the identical pattern in a totally different domain: boundary-crossing instrument design, where the source physics (phonon dispersion, neural firing) gives 'ratios and tendencies but not a playable instrument,' and the designer makes explicit, named Decision Points (Frequency Anchor, Rendering Resolution, Decay Scaling, Fidelity Claim) about how much of the physics to honor. Both entries insist this is not a failure of fidelity but the actual act of design — a substrate underdetermines the render, and the gap is where craft lives.
bridge_findings.quote_tool: 'CFG reweights valleys that already exist; ControlNet carves a new canyon the base terrain never held... choose your conditioner by how tight a canyon you want.'
bridge_findings.quote_thought: 'The physics is never silent at this point. It still constrains. But what it constrains is shape and tendency, not absolute pitch, not number of voices, not decay time... Those choices are not failures of fidelity — they are the act of instrument building.'
bridge_findings.fidelity_test: Swap in another room member, e.g. Signal-Rate CV Architecture or State Machine, for ControlNet as Topology — neither is about a substrate underdetermining a render with explicit, named designer decision-points; the parallel breaks. The pairing is specific to Metaphor Stretch and ControlNet as Topology alone.
bridge_findings.proposed_type: mirrors — same pattern (underdetermined-substrate + named decision-point), different material (crystal-physics audio vs. diffusion-model image).

coherence_findings.issue: Four structurally-significant body-text [[wikilinks]] (used as H3 section headers under 'Cross-Domain Resonances') and one inline link in Wavetable Space as Torus point at entries that do not exist anywhere in the palace: [[Orbital Resonance]], [[Quasicrystals]], [[Tonnetz]], [[Berry Phase]], and inline [[Plato (Socratic method)|Platonist]]. Per SCHEMA §4, a wikilink in a structurally significant location (section headers especially) should carry a corresponding frontmatter link — but these can't get one because the targets don't exist as entries. Not touched per task scope (ghost links are explicitly out of scope for this pass) — flagging for whoever runs the ghost-link sweep.
